warriorResources.awarenessTitle: Know the scam before it finds you
warriorResources.awarenessCopy: Ten real patterns, told the way they actually happen. Open any card to read the full story and what to do about it.
warriorResources.awarenessHelpline: If any of this is happening to you right now, call 1930 immediately - the first hour matters most.

poster.identity-theftTitle: They don't need to meet you to steal you
poster.identity-theftStory: A call claiming to be your bank, a message with a fake login page, a cloned card at checkout - three different tricks, one goal: your identity in someone else's hands.
poster.identity-theftAdvice: No bank ever asks for your PIN or OTP. Hang up and call the number printed on your own card.
poster.qr-upi-scamTitle: Scanning a code can empty your account
poster.qr-upi-scamStory: Someone sends a QR code and says scanning it will send you money. You scan, enter your UPI PIN, and the amount leaves your account instead of arriving in it.
poster.qr-upi-scamAdvice: To receive money you never scan a code or enter a PIN. A PIN only ever authorises money going out.
poster.sim-swap-fraudTitle: Your number, stolen without touching your phone
poster.sim-swap-fraudStory: A fraudster convinces your telecom provider to issue a duplicate SIM in your name. Your phone goes dead - and every OTP meant for you now lands in their hands instead.
poster.sim-swap-fraudAdvice: If your signal disappears for no reason, treat it as an emergency: call your bank and your operator immediately.
poster.prepaid-task-scamStory: Small tasks - liking videos, rating hotels - pay out real money at first, to earn your trust. Then the 'investment' needed to unlock bigger earnings vanishes the moment it is paid.
poster.prepaid-task-scamAdvice: A job that asks you to pay first isn't a job. Real work never requires a deposit to start earning.
poster.loan-app-harassmentStory: Instant approval, no paperwork, no credit check - then the app harvests your contacts and photos, and threatens to shame you to everyone you know unless you pay far more than you borrowed.
poster.loan-app-harassmentAdvice: A real lender never threatens your contacts. Report the app and the harassment - do not pay the fear.
poster.matrimonial-scamTitle: Falling in love with a profile that isn't real
poster.matrimonial-scamStory: Weeks of messages, promises and a growing bond - then an emergency abroad, a stuck shipment, or a medical crisis that only your money can solve.
poster.matrimonial-scamAdvice: If you have never met them in person, do not send money - no matter how urgent the story sounds.
poster.webcam-blackmailTitle: They recorded the call you can't take back
poster.webcam-blackmailStory: A friendly video chat with a stranger turns into a screen-recorded compromising clip - followed by a demand for money to keep it from reaching your family and contacts.
poster.webcam-blackmailAdvice: Do not pay - paying never makes it stop. End the call, block, preserve evidence, and report immediately.
poster.misinformationStory: A viral message spreads faster than the facts behind it ever could. One pause to check the source can stop panic, rumours, or a scam before it reaches someone else.
poster.misinformationAdvice: Before you forward it, check who wrote it, why, and where it first appeared. Verify, then share.
poster.otp-remote-accessTitle: One tap away from losing everything
poster.otp-remote-accessStory: A 'bank support' caller convinces you to install a remote-access app to 'fix' a problem - then watches your screen live as your OTP, password and money disappear.
poster.otp-remote-accessAdvice: Never install a remote-access app because of a phone call. Hang up, verify independently, and report.
poster.first-hour-after-fraudStory: Cyber fraud can often be reversed - but only if you act fast. Every minute of delay makes the money harder to trace and recover.
poster.first-hour-after-fraudAdvice: Don't wait to be sure. Call 1930 the moment it happens - reporting early is what makes recovery possible.

warriorResources.tipPasswordsSummary: Practical steps to secure your email, banking and social media accounts.
warriorResources.tipPasswordsBody: Use a unique, strong password for every account, turn on two-factor authentication wherever it's offered, and never share OTPs or passwords with anyone - not even someone claiming to be your bank.
warriorResources.tipPhishingSummary: Best practices for safe and responsible use of social media platforms.
warriorResources.tipPhishingBody: Be wary of urgent messages asking you to click a link or verify your account. Check the sender's actual email address or number, and go directly to the official website or app instead of clicking links in messages.
warriorResources.tipReportingSummary: Step-by-step guidance on reporting cybercrime through this portal.
warriorResources.tipReportingBody: Use the Report Cybercrime flow from your dashboard, choose the closest matching category, describe what happened with dates and platform details, and attach any screenshots or documents as evidence.
warriorResources.tipEvidenceSummary: Essential tips to protect yourself from common online threats and scams.
warriorResources.tipEvidenceBody: Take full-screen screenshots that include dates, usernames, and URLs. Do not edit or crop evidence. Save chat exports as a single file where possible.
warriorResources.tipPrivacySummary: Understand how your report and evidence are handled.
warriorResources.tipPrivacyBody: Reports and evidence are only visible to you and authorized reviewers. Never include another person's private data in a report unless it's directly relevant to the incident.
